title: Machine for skipping a record part
statement: For each natural number $k$ and Boolean parameter $b$, define a machine with $k+2$ work tapes, Boolean tape alphabet, and the state type selected by $b$. When $b$ is false, this machine is the record-processing machine of width $4k+4$; when $b$ is true, it is the successor-field machine with the table tape as source, the summary tape as destination, and copying disabled.
